{{Short description|Mathematical tiling}}
[[File:Tiling Dual Semiregular V4-6-12 Bisected Hexagonal.svg|thumb|Euclidean kisrhombille tiling]]
In [[geometry]], a '''kisrhombille''' is a [[uniform tiling]] of [[rhombus|rhombic]] faces, divided by central points into four triangles.

Examples:
* [[3-6 kisrhombille]] &ndash; Euclidean plane
* [[3-7 kisrhombille]] &ndash; hyperbolic plane
* [[Truncated_trioctagonal_tiling#Order 3-8 kisrhombille|3-8 kisrhombille]] &ndash; hyperbolic plane
* [[4-5 kisrhombille]] &ndash; hyperbolic plane
